correctness.rationale: The graph is precisely the undirected fully periodic C5□C6, no diagonals, degree four at each of 30 vertices. Independent exact bitset enumeration found 199,821 faces including the empty face, f-vector (30,375,2560,10545,27450,46230,51000,37080,17790,5580,1080,100), and an ascending pivot matching of 99,910 disjoint pairs leaving the sole six-vertex face mask 4342820 (dimension five). Oriented Hasse graph of all 1,347,900 covers was independently topologically sorted across all 199,821 faces; no cycle. The empty face is matched, so augmented discrete Morse gives one nonempty critical 5-cell and hence a pointed S5 CW model. Independent script reconstructed the exact finite universe and acyclicity, beyond relying on saved stdout; no extrapolation to all tori.
